evidence.decision: Assigns scroll ownership and minimal automatic reveal, separating same-axis conflicts from appropriate orthogonal nesting.
evidence.artifact: Requires a scroll/reveal implementation or axis/ownership/position/edge-effect specification with bounded zoom behavior.
evidence.transformation: Nested long-note example collapses competing vertical owners and replaces recenter-on-every-character with minimal insertion-point reveal.
evidence.verification: Checks offscreen typing, search results, extending selection, boundaries and floating controls; fails unreachable content, trapped input or excessive jumps.
evidence.applicability: Preserves TV focus scrolling, watch vertical Crown input and per-view visionOS Look to Scroll opt-in with clear boundaries and no custom parallax.
evidence.handoffs: Uses page-controls for peer position and split-views for independent pane scrolling rather than assuming all scroll owners are interchangeable.
evidence.distinctiveness: Minimal reveal, scroll-axis ownership and opt-in eye scrolling produce specific consequential scrolling decisions and observable failures.
